info.title: Amp External API
info.description:
The Amp External API allows integrations to interact with Amp workspace data.

All data access is scoped to the Amp workspace that owns the provided client credentials.

If your workspace has a required custom domain, send API requests to `https://YOUR_WORKSPACE_DOMAIN/api/v2` instead of `https://ampcode.com/api/v2`. Use your workspace domain in the request examples below. For Sign in with Amp OAuth, keep `resource=https://ampcode.com/api/v2` in the authorization request.

To use this API, create a [External API Application](https://ampcode.com/workspace/applications) in your workspace. Right now, only machine-to-machine applications can be created; Sign in with Amp applications are not generally available.

For integrations and automations using the Amp product itself, use the [Amp CLI](https://ampcode.com/install) or [Amp SDK](https://ampcode.com/docs/sdk) instead.

v2.SignInWithAmpOIDC.description: Sign in with Amp OIDC ID token for identity-only operations. The actor endpoint requires an ID token issued with the openid, profile, and email scopes. ID tokens cannot authorize Amp data scopes.

v2.SignInWithAmpOAuth.description: Sign in with Amp OAuth access token. Include resource=https://ampcode.com/api/v2 in the authorization request. Amp requires that resource as the token audience and reads the exact scopes from the signed token. Amp also verifies the registered application, selected workspace, current membership, and user permissions.

estimatedProviderCostAtListPriceUSD.description:
EXPERIMENTAL. Estimated USD cost of bring-your-own-key (BYOK) inference in this thread, computed from token usage at the model provider’s public list price at the time of the request. This is what the customer would have paid the provider (for example Anthropic or OpenAI) at list price; it is not billed by Amp and is not included in the usage field.

This is only an estimate. Amp cannot see negotiated pricing, discounts, committed-use contracts, or free-tier allowances a customer has with a provider, and the estimate does not include markups or fees charged by AI routers or gateways. Requests sent through an AI router connection (for example OpenRouter) are not estimated at all and contribute 0, because Amp has no list price for router-served models. Requests served through subscription connections (such as ChatGPT or Claude subscriptions) are excluded because they have no per-token provider bill. Requests made before 2026-08-26 are not included.

Contact Amp support before relying on this value for billing, chargeback, or reporting; its name, semantics, and availability may change without notice.

estimatedProviderCostAtListPriceUSD.description:
EXPERIMENTAL. Estimated USD cost of bring-your-own-key (BYOK) inference by the user on that day, computed from token usage at the model provider’s public list price at the time of the request. This is what the customer would have paid the provider (for example Anthropic or OpenAI) at list price; it is not billed by Amp and is not included in the usage field.

This is only an estimate. Amp cannot see negotiated pricing, discounts, committed-use contracts, or free-tier allowances a customer has with a provider, and the estimate does not include markups or fees charged by AI routers or gateways. Requests sent through an AI router connection (for example OpenRouter) are not estimated at all and contribute 0, because Amp has no list price for router-served models. Requests served through subscription connections (such as ChatGPT or Claude subscriptions) are excluded because they have no per-token provider bill. Requests made before 2026-08-26 are not included.

Contact Amp support before relying on this value for billing, chargeback, or reporting; its name, semantics, and availability may change without notice.
